example_sentences_in_bangla: কানের মাথা খেয়েছো নাকি? এতক্ষণ ডাকছি, শুনতে পাচ্ছ না!
বাবা, কানের মাথা খেয়ে ফেলেছো কি? নাম বললাম শোনো না!
example_sentences_in_english: Have you eaten the top of your ear? I've been calling you for so long and you can't hear!
Dad, have you lost the top of your ear? I said your name and you didn't hear!
note: This idiom is used teasingly to scold someone for not paying attention or pretending not to hear.
